ja270:1.1: Over all my relatives, it seems,
ja270:1.2: the owl has been made ruler,
ja270:1.3: If I have permission of my relatives,
ja270:2.2: all that is Dhamma and meaningful,
ja270:2.4: they’re endowed with wisdom and brilliance.
ja270:3.1: Good luck to you, but I do not like
ja270:3.3: Look at his face when not angry,
ja270:3.4: what will it be when made angry?
